This Father’s Day, my heart aches with the familiar pain of missing my dad. Parkinson’s and dementia took him from us, but sometimes the things that shatter us  bring us more points of connection.  We  need a national movement that supports families dealing with Alzheimers and dementia, we can do so much better as a nation. 

To every caregiver showing up with love at home — you are not alone. You are heroes.  Let's remember that strength is measured most  by how we love and care for others.

Our tax system is broken and it’s unfair. The wealthiest Americans pay effective rates under 10%, while working families carry 25, 30, even 40%. Enough. 

Close the loopholes and raise the standard deduction to $75,000 so hard working Americans keep more of their pay.
